multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: all 24 journey slices are integrated in every stage

checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run lint && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run test && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run build
checks.proves: Field runtime passes its declared static, source, contract, and export gates.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove backend, providers, or devices.
checks.passCriteria: All four commands pass on the resulting SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Any failure or different SHA fails.

checks.proves: DSH backend and database test suites pass on the resulting SHA.
checks.doesNotProve: It does not prove all external providers.
checks.passCriteria: All tests pass without ignored required failures.
checks.failCriteria: Any failure, race, or incompatible migration fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: execute MAN-01 through MAN-14 for every mapped outcome and record all five-surface readback
checks.proves: Positive, negative, concurrency, offline, dependency, restart, accessibility, convergence, and cleanup behavior is proven.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires complete test environments and actors.
checks.passCriteria: Every case passes with retained screenshots, requests, data/event evidence, and decisions.
checks.failCriteria: Any missing case, stale reader, false success, or legacy route fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: build physical Android and iOS development and release variants and test push, deep links, background tasks, permissions, media, GPS, process death, reboot, updates, TalkBack, and VoiceOver
checks.proves: Native lifecycle and accessibility behavior is proven outside Expo Go.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires signing credentials and physical devices.
checks.passCriteria: All platform cases pass and known platform differences are documented.
checks.failCriteria: Any release-only, permission, lifecycle, or accessibility failure fails.

checks.command: MANUAL: deploy one resulting SHA with compatible migrations, verify providers and source maps, exercise rollback-forward, and confirm same-SHA readback
checks.proves: Release, migration, runtime, observability, and evidence refer to one commit.
checks.doesNotProve: Requires deployment authority and provider credentials.
checks.passCriteria: All artifacts and evidence identify the same SHA and rollback-forward succeeds.
checks.failCriteria: Any SHA mismatch, migration risk, provider failure, or unverifiable artifact fails.
